name: io.github.tonyyang0504/newegg-mcp
description: Newegg Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Newegg Marketplace API key assigned by the Newegg integration team (or your third-party developer key); sent verbatim as the Authorization header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The seller's Secret Key (assigned to you, or to your third-party developer on the seller's authorization); sent as the SecretKey header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_SELLER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Newegg seller ID (e.g. A006); sent as ?sellerid= on every call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_COUNTRY_CODE
environmentVariables.description: ISO 3-letter ship-to country your prices target, e.g. USA; used in PriceList.Price[].CountryCode by update_listing/end_listing.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Currency matching country_code, e.g. USD for USA (wrong combinations are rejected).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NEWEGG_WAREHOUSE_LOCATION
environmentVariables.description: ISO 3-letter country of the warehouse whose stock set_inventory writes, e.g. USA.
